comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
This was obtainable from Halo Ticket at Valentine Papaya Site UWC Shop in 2019. It is rare to get it as the rate is roughly 1 to 100. Stats are as follow:

100/100 durability
+5 defence
+2 Archaeology
+2 Theology

EX effect: Rank 5 Vigour cost reduction (not applied for production)
